IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
wavy blonde hair holds a wine glass
while leaning against a wooden ledge.
She wears a pale blue cropped baby tee
with a script graphic, a black faux-fur
vest, dark straight-leg jeans, and black
platform boots. A thin silver necklace sits
at her throat. Her expression is calm. A
glass wall with a red curtain behind her
and soft daylight. Palette of powder blue,
black, and wood brown. Casual and
relaxed, in the style of a city street-style
photo.
